answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil attacks by binding identity to scarce, revocable resources instead of free keypairs. Newcomers post a stake that a quorum of established members must co-sign; those endorsements form a trellis of trust, each account hanging from a verified one, so a thousand fakes would need a thousand real sponsors. Reputation flows along that vine, and any ripple of collusion surfaces early. A public terrace of audited identities keeps forgery expensive and honest participation cheap.
